svg.title: My developer journey
svg.desc: Raghvendra Gupta stands beside three things he builds: AI & computer vision, interactive 3D web apps, and practical student platforms.

g.text: Learn it — Build it — Ship it
BCA Student at SRHU by day, AI & full-stack builder by night.
Real-time posture detection & gesture interactions with MediaPipe & Python
Responsive, pixel-perfect web apps with React, Three.js, JavaScript & CSS
Building real-world student tools, health tech & hackathon solutions
“Turning theoretical concepts into functional, real-world software.”
STUDENT · 9+ REPOS · HACKATHON PARTICIPANT · BCA 2ND YEAR
